purpose: Freeze the exact scope-semantics and canonical scope-hash convention used by OPWS R1. These semantics reuse the repository-relative normalized file-identity convention already used by MAIN_297 / the frozen prediction artifacts. No prediction is changed by this contract.

scope_for_each_arm_task.task_id: frozen task identity from the MAIN_297 manifest (later bounded to the frozen Full-D7 READY population)
scope_for_each_arm_task.normalized_selected_file_list: repository-relative paths, POSIX forward slashes, deduplicated, sorted lexicographically (byte order) for hashing; exactly the paths stored in the frozen prediction artifact
scope_for_each_arm_task.selected_scope_hash: canonical deterministic scope hash defined below

existing_convention_reuse.file_identity: repository-relative, forward slashes, exact strings as stored in the frozen artifacts (census / proxies / candidate_universe / per-arm prediction artifacts)
existing_convention_reuse.no_os_slash_dependency: paths are never OS-normalized (no backslash conversion, no drive letters, no case folding)
existing_convention_reuse.no_aliases: a path has exactly one canonical spelling; no symlink aliasing is applied
existing_convention_reuse.no_duplicates: duplicate paths are removed before hashing; the duplicate count is recorded (duplicate_prediction_count)

canonical_scope_hash_definition.canonical_json: json.dumps(normalized_selected_file_list, sort_keys=False) with separators=('\'\',\'\':\'\') on the ALREADY SORTED list
canonical_scope_hash_definition.hash_input: the canonical JSON string encoded utf-8
canonical_scope_hash_definition.empty_scope_hash: defined for the EMPTY list; EMPTY prediction is a VALID zero-size scope (selected_file_count == 0), never missing data
canonical_scope_hash_definition.determinism_property: same set of paths in any input order yields the same hash after normalization+sorted canonical serialization

scope_records_manifest.population_bound_note: Per-arm/per-task scope manifests are materialized AFTER population binding from the frozen artifacts; this freeze fixes the semantics, not the (unbound) task list.
scope_records_manifest.no_gold_backfill: no path is added to any arm's list based on gold or reference-patch knowledge
scope_records_manifest.emph_empty_valid: an arm with an empty selected list is recorded as scope_size 0 and opws scope-hash of the empty list; it is NOT omitted

selection_source_priority.RANDOM_SIZE_MATCHED_RM_CSS: deterministic size-matched sample (seed 20261012) from the same per-task universe
